title: Polish individual team pages on mobile

criteria.text: Match History team names are readable at 390 and 360: name box wider (was 75.6px at 390), up to 2 lines, logo link no longer forces 44px width
Match History logo links are not extra tab stops (aria-hidden + tabIndex -1); the name link stays focusable
Match History team names meet 4.5:1 contrast in the light theme
Roster chips show names up to about 160px wide without cutting them at 80px (PlayerList only, PlayerChip default unchanged)
Career power-score chart: first x label and y-axis title are not clipped at 360 and 390
Last match link is at least 44px tall and 'Last match:' does not wrap; Report Card Season/Career toggles are at least 44px tall
Back button on a direct or shared link goes to /teams instead of leaving the app
Error text has no double period, and 'No Match History' text is hidden when matches failed to load
No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 360 and 390 on all four team routes, touched components' tests pass

notes.text: Left alone on purpose: hero logo size 144 vs 112 (look change, needs Doug), hero badges div->button (shared with home/standings cards), sticky nav wrong active pill (logic change, follow-up), shared colours/components (power-score colours, Tabs, Select, site header), global scroll-padding. Human choice earlier: fake-data screenshots.
